import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int a, b, cap, flow;
        Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static int n, t;
    static String[] a, b;
    static int[][] d1 = new int[30][30];
    static int[][] d2 = new int[30][30];
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static ArrayList<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g;
    static int source, sink;
    static int[] dist, ptr, q;

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        e.add(new Edge(a, b, cap, 0));
        e.add(new Edge(b, a, 0, 0));
        g[a].add(e.size() - 2);
        g[b].add(e.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void BFS1(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) Arrays.fill(d1[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        Queue<int[]> qq = new LinkedList<>();
        qq.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        d1[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = qq.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (ok(nx, ny) && d1[nx][ny] >= Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2 && b[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    d1[nx][ny] = d1[x][y] + 1;
                    qq.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        int qh = 0, qt = 0;
        q[qt++] = source;
        dist[source] = 0;
        while (qh < qt && dist[sink] == -1) {
            int v = q[qh++];
            for (int id : g[v]) {
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (dist[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                    q[qt++] = to;
                    dist[to] = dist[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == sink) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ptr[v]++) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            int to = e.get(id).b;
            if (dist[to] != dist[v] + 1) continue;
            int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static void BFS2(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) Arrays.fill(d2[i], Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2);
        Queue<int[]> qq = new LinkedList<>();
        qq.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        d2[sx][sy] = 0;
        while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = qq.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            if (d2[x][y] >= d1[x][y]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (ok(nx, ny) && d2[nx][ny] >= Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2 && a[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && d2[x][y] + 1 <= d1[nx][ny]) {
                    d2[nx][ny] = d2[x][y] + 1;
                    qq.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        a = new String[n];
        b = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = br.readLine();
        int wx = 0, wy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            b[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (b[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    // replace 'Z' with 'Y' in both grids
                    char[] aChars = a[i].toCharArray();
                    aChars[j] = 'Y';
                    a[i] = new String(aChars);
                    char[] bChars = b[i].toCharArray();
                    bChars[j] = 'Y';
                    b[i] = new String(bChars);
                    wx = i;
                    wy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        BFS1(wx, wy);
        int maxNodes = 2 * n * n + 5;
        g = new ArrayList[maxNodes];
        for (int i = 0; i < maxNodes; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        source = 0;
        sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        dist = new int[maxNodes];
        ptr = new int[maxNodes];
        q = new int[maxNodes];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int what = i * n + j + 1;
                int what2 = n * n + i * n + j + 1;
                add_edge(source, what, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                add_edge(what2, sink, b[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                BFS2(i, j);
                for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                        if (b[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || d2[x][y] > t) continue;
                        add_edge(what, n * n + x * n + y + 1, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
